mutations.name: #7096: a FAILED fresh read releases the head (the latch fails open — reddens TestNotRevertedReadFailsClosed)
mutations.old: firstLineOf(err.Error()) + "), so it still holds." + tail, true
mutations.new: firstLineOf(err.Error()) + "), so it still holds." + tail, false

mutations.name: #7096: a fresh read that returns NOTHING releases the head (reddens TestNotRevertedReadFailsClosed)
mutations.old: "returned nothing, so it still holds." + tail, true
mutations.new: "returned nothing, so it still holds." + tail, false

mutations.name: #7096: a fresh read of ANOTHER head (or none) releases this one (reddens TestNotRevertedReadFailsClosed)
#7096: a backend serving NO requirement read releases the head (reddens TestNotRevertedReadFailsClosed)
#7096: an unrecognised or empty recorded cause is treated as cleared (reddens TestNotRevertedReadFailsClosed)
#7096: the loop cap is lifted (a head reverted three times is re-read and flipped again — reddens TestNotRevertedCapAndNoRead)
#7096: a legacy (no-cause) or unreadable-cause marker clears on a PARTIAL read (reddens TestNotRevertedLegacyMarker)
#7096: a mergeable UNKNOWN that never settles is recorded as a cause (the backstop reverts and writes the marker — reddens TestBackstopMergeableUnknownNeverSettles)
#7096: mergeable UNKNOWN is judged at once instead of re-read (reddens TestBackstopMergeableUnknownSettles)
#7096: the revert marker records no cause (every revert reads legacy — reddens TestBackstopRevertRecordsCause)
#7096: the pre-fix latch (every matched revert holds, even once a fresh read shows its cause cleared — reddens TestNotRevertedCauseCleared and TestNotRevertedLegacyMarker)
mutations.old: "read shows that cleared, so the revert no longer holds this head", pr, shown, strings.Join(cleared, "; ")), false
mutations.new: "read shows that cleared, so the revert no longer holds this head", pr, shown, strings.Join(cleared, "; ")), true
